'''First Reasoner''' is the title of the [[Ajah Head|Head]] of the [[White Ajah]].

==Title holders==

[[Ferane Neheran]] is the First Reasoner, and she held that office and a [[Sitter|seat]] in the [[Hall of the Tower during the White Tower Schism|Tower Hall]] during the [[White Tower Schism]]. It is unknown who held the office among the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]]. It has been suggested that because [[Myrelle]], who was also part of the cabal that organized the rebellion, was the Captain-General among the Greens, [[Carlinya]] may have led the White rebels.
